channel.title: Kai-Bin Wong — Blog
channel.description: Notes from a VFX editor who ships software.

item.title: 78% of my plan on day one. The org chart was the fix.
item.description: Fifteen bots, all talking to my Chief of Staff, all asking me for approval. By my own count I burned through about 78% of my daily platform plan that day. The biggest fix wasn't a config setting. It was deciding who reports to whom.

item.title: The bots don't talk to each other. They write it down
item.description: How my coding agent and three checker bots hand work back and forth through a shared log, and where that log is weaker than it looks.

item.title: Three AI checkers, and nobody whose job was to ask them.
item.description: The bot that fixed my spam was the one I hired in a hurry.

item.title: My AI wrote the code. Three other AIs tried to stop it shipping.
item.description: I built the bots first and the org chart second. This is the log from the morning that went wrong, and the chart I put in place at 11:26.
